text:
The period most likely began about one month after the widow's death in 1986, when the tenant decided to stay and stopped paying rent, since that was the first clear repudiation of the tenancy. The shared note is wrong that her death ended the lease: the lease survived and bound the Boy Scouts as successor to her reversion, so the death alone did not start adverse possession. Whether that repudiation was communicated to the owner or was open and notorious is not resolved by the facts, and if it was not, the clock may not have started until later and the 20 years may not have run before 2009.

CONFIDENCE: 50
